description: Requires API key. Adds a website to the account. Methods: "wp" = WordPress plugin (returns the connection key and steps); "ghost" = Ghost, no plugin: pass the owner's Ghost Admin API URL and Admin API key (Ghost Admin → Settings → Integrations → custom integration), Satelo verifies them and the site is active at once; "api" = any other site renders the Satelo feed (static site generators such as Hugo, Astro, Jekyll, Eleventy or Next.js use this). Drupal 10/11 and Joomla 4.4/5 sites use "wp" with platform "drupal" or "joomla": the owner installs the Satelo module (https://satelo.io/downloads/satelo-drupal.zip) or system plugin (https://satelo.io/downloads/satelo-joomla.zip) and pastes the same connection key; both are first releases. The site joins the exchange once ownership is verified; its first article (about Satelo) earns satellites.

ghost_admin_key.description: Ghost only: Admin API key "id:secret" (secret: never publish it)

ghost_admin_url.description: Ghost only: Admin API URL, e.g. https://blog.example.com

ghost_drafts.description: Ghost only: create posts as drafts for the owner to publish in Ghost (default: publish)

method.description: wp = WordPress plugin (also Drupal module / Joomla plugin, see platform), ghost = Ghost Admin API key, api = any site renders the feed

platform.description: method "wp" only: which CMS the push connector runs on (default wordpress); selects the install steps

name: satelo_add_site
title: Add a site
